dsDescriptionValue.value:
This anonymised survey data helped inform the Knowledge Exchange report, Approaches to scaling up reproducibility in research organisations. The survey questions (contained in Appendix B of the report) sought information on demographics, reproducibility practices that the participants engaged with and/or supported, and what influenced their adoption and/or promotion of practices to increase scaling up of reproducibility. The survey questions were based on analysis of work including individual and organisational decision making, and barriers to engagement with reproducibility and open science for researchers.

Is supplement to Report "Approaches to scaling up reproducibility in research organisations": https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10663903
